# GPU-Managed Variant Buffer Update Logic (from [S2, unofficial])

The claim accurately reflects the details provided in Source [S2]. Specifically: 1) The LRU buffer stores linear indices sorted by access time (Section 5.6, 8.3.2). 2) The usage buffer stores timestamps (Section 5.6, 8.3.2). 3) The update logic involves generating a mask M from the usage buffer for timestamp t, moving marked indices (Lu+) to the front, and unmarked indices (Lu-) to the back while preserving relative order (Section 5.6, Figure 5.4 caption). 4) The brick cache is a single-channel 3D texture in r8unorm format (Section 8.3.2). 5) Cache size Csize is user-defined and rounded to a multiple of brick size Bsize (Section 8.3.2).
